title: RepoDeclaration
description: OWM 0.1 repo declaration (conventional filename: watermark.owm.json). A model publisher places this in the model repository (Hugging Face or elsewhere) to declare that outputs are watermarked and how a third party can verify. It is the PUBLIC-SAFE subset of a deployment's configuration: fingerprints and verification pointers, never key references or sealed material, and parameters only under an explicitly public disclosure.

subject.description: What is being declared about. hf:org/name for Hugging Face repos; any URI scheme is allowed.

revision.description: commit or tag the declaration applies to

artifacts.description: Named artifact fingerprints, e.g. {tokenizer: sha256:..., weights: sha256:..., vae: sha256:...}. Lets a verifier confirm they hold the artifacts the marking assumed.

marking.description: One entry per active or historical marking configuration. Multiple entries cover rotation history and multi-modality models.

config_fingerprint.description: Hash of the canonical configuration (scheme, version, parameters, key lineage id and version). Commits the publisher to a configuration without disclosing it.

params.description: Scheme parameters, present ONLY when the publisher has chosen public disclosure; omitted otherwise. Never contains key material in any case.

verification.description: How a third party verifies. At least one of detector, endpoint or bundle should be present for the declaration to be actionable; a declaration without any is a statement of marking only.

detector.description: Published detector artifact (discloses key material for some schemes)

endpoint.description: A detect-only verification API the publisher operates

bundle.description: Offline verification bundle (configs + null models + detectors)

spoofing_not_excluded.description: MUST be true whenever a detector or the parameters are public: anyone holding them can forge the mark. Verifiers surface this on every result.

fpr_target.description: The false-positive target the publisher calibrated against

public_key_hex.description: Ed25519 public key of the signing deployment (hex, raw 32 bytes)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (hex) over the canonical JSON of this document with signature and public_key_hex removed. Lets a verifier pin the declaration to the deployment that produced it.
